newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BEWARE SUAVE KILLER, S.AFRICAN POLICE URGE WOMEN.
newsitem.headline: BEWARE SUAVE KILLER, S.AFRICAN POLICE URGE WOMEN.

text.p: A killer terrorising Johannesburg is a bright, smart man who has murdered at least 14 women out of hatred of their sex, South African police said on Friday.

"The killer is intelligent and he is well dressed. He is very convincing but manipulates people easily. One would not suspect that he is a serial killer," said police forensic psychologist Micki Pistorius.

The Nasrec murderer, named after the city's exhibition centre near which many of his victims' bodies were found, is the sixth serial killer to emerge in two years in a country plagued by violent crime.
"He has a deep-seated hatred of women and demands submissiveness from them," Pistorius said in a statement.
"The killer's victims are black woman, mostly between the ages of 20 and 35, but any woman could be considered a potential victim."
The killer preys on women passengers of minibus taxis and is believed to be in his 20s or 30s.
The worst suspected killer, Moses Sithole, goes on trial next month for the alleged murder of more than 30 women.
